verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions BigQuery's REST and gRPC Storage Write APIs, a Rust SDK, the bq CLI and ODBC/JDBC drivers, but none of it documents a downloadable machine-readable API spec such as an OpenAPI document, discovery document or published proto files. Having APIs and SDKs is not the same as offering a downloadable spec, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
